name: digest
title: Digest
description: The morning brief: two sources, search and calendar. Search files fresh headlines for the operator's topics through any installed search provider; calendar mirrors the coming week's events. Everything lands in one urgency-sorted feed of cards the operator opens, stars, snoozes, marks read or keeps a draft note on. It learns continuously: dismissals tune the interest filter, and score feedback grows taste rules the prioritizer reads.

gateways.purpose: card scoring, the taste distiller, the dismissal learner
first-run receipt: a fresh un-onboarded install gets the Nyo onboarding pointer instead of day-zero noise

host_reads.purpose: the calendar source's look-ahead cards; the drawer's event context
activity-bus reads: last-generated stamp, dismissal-learning marker

knowledge.purpose: writer_small model id for the light dismissal-learning pass

tables.name: plugin_digest_items
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_digest_items (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ref_kind TEXT, ref_id TEXT, title TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT, source_label TEXT, source_url TEXT, urgency INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 2, actionable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, suggested_action TEXT, starred INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, read_at INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, meta_json TEXT); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_digest_items_created_at ON plugin_digest_items (created_at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_digest_items_read_at ON plugin_digest_items (read_at)

tables.name: plugin_digest_signal_snoozes
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_digest_signal_snoozes (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, until INTEGER NOT NULL, label TEXT, reason TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, engaged_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_engaged_at INTEGER); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_plugin_digest_signal_snoozes_until ON plugin_digest_signal_snoozes (until)

capabilities.purpose: headline lookups for the search source's topics: any installed search provider

def.name: add_digest_item
def.description: Manually drop something into the digest. Use when the operator says "remind me about X tomorrow" or "add this to the brief". Kind=opportunity for net-new chances; kind=note for free-form items; kind=news for a headline with a link.

def.name: clear_read_digest
def.description: Delete every already-read digest item (the archive sweep). Unread and starred items stay. Use when the operator asks to clean the brief's history.

def.name: digest_actions
def.description: List the actions an operator can take on one digest item: open its link, mark it read (or unread), star it, save a draft note on it, or snooze it (a news card snoozes its outlet, a calendar card snoozes that event). Returns the item, its context, and the action list; run one with execute_digest_action.

def.name: digest_context
def.description: Source-enriched context for one digest item: the item itself, and for calendar cards the underlying calendar event (time, location, link). Use before discussing an item or deciding what to do with it.

def.name: digest_sources
def.description: What feeds the Digest on this install: installed search providers (discovered by capability), whether the calendar source is present, and the watched topics. Use to answer "where does my brief pull from?" or before onboarding.

def.name: digest_stats
def.description: Counts: total / unread / high-urgency / actionable / starred, plus when the digest last generated. Use for quick "how does my morning look?" reads.

def.name: execute_digest_action
def.description: Execute one action on a digest item. type=open_link logs the open and returns the url; type=mark_read sets read (pass read:false to un-read); type=star sets starred (pass starred:false to unstar; omitted toggles); type=save_draft stores draft text as the card's note; type=snooze keeps the card's key (its outlet for news, the event for calendar) out of the brief for snooze_days and archives its unread siblings.

draft.description: save_draft: the note text (max 2000 chars kept)

def.name: generate_digest
def.description: Scan and materialize new digest items. Prunes what has gone stale, then pulls the two sources this install has (search headlines for the operator's topics through any installed search provider, and the calendar look-ahead), deduping against existing items. Run when the operator says "give me today's brief", "what's new?", or first thing each morning.

def.name: learn_dismissals
def.description: Learn from what the operator dismissed in the digest and tune the interest filter: reads the recent dismissed-not-starred items, asks the model what to avoid, and appends the learned avoid-list to the plugin-digest-interests note. No-op unless enough new dismissals accumulated since the last pass — pass force:true to learn now regardless. Use when the operator says "stop showing me this stuff" or "the digest is noisy".

force.description: learn even below the new-dismissals threshold

lookback_days.description: how far back to harvest dismissals (default 21)

def.name: list_digest
def.description: Read today's digest items, the morning brief. Sources: search headlines for the operator's topics and the calendar look-ahead. Default returns UNREAD items, urgency-sorted (high first). Set unread_only=false to see everything.

def.name: mark_digest_read
def.description: Mark a digest item as read (dismisses it from the unread list). Use after Nyo has acted on or answered an item for the operator.

read.description: default true; pass false to mark unread again

def.name: prioritize_signals
def.description: Score every unread, unscored digest card of a scored kind (bounded batch) so the brief reads most-relevant first and background noise last. Safe to run repeatedly; scored items are skipped. Rubric, score_kinds and thresholds live in the plugin-digest-signal-priority knowledge doc.

limit.description: max cards this run (default from the doc)

def.name: read_digest_topics
def.description: Read the watched topics the Digest currently searches for.

def.name: run_digest
def.description: Run the digest tick the cron runs at :30: prune what has gone stale, pull search headlines and the calendar look-ahead, dedupe against what is already there. Safe to run by hand to refresh the morning digest now.

def.name: save_digest_draft
def.description: Save the operator's draft note on a digest card (auto-save from the page). The note lives on the card and shows again whenever it is opened.

draft.description: the current note text (max 2000 chars kept)

def.name: save_digest_topics
def.description: Save the watched topics the Digest searches for (max 5 short search queries). Replaces the list in the Digest search topics knowledge doc.

def.name: score_signal
def.description: Score ONE digest card for the attention it deserves (0-100 + a one-line reason) against the plugin-digest-signal-priority rubric, the operator's interest profile and learned taste rules. The score remaps the card into the brief's high/mid/low groups.

def.name: signal_feedback
def.description: Teach the scorer the operator's taste: pass their comment on a card's priority verdict. The comment distills into durable taste rules in the plugin-digest-signal-priority knowledge doc (bounded) and the card is immediately rescored under the updated rubric.

def.name: signal_snooze
def.description: Snooze a digest card for a while (snooze_days in the plugin-digest-signal-priority doc, default 7): a news card mutes its outlet, a calendar card mutes that event. Archives the card and its unread siblings on the same key and keeps new arrivals on that key out of the brief until the snooze expires.

def.name: signal_unsnooze
def.description: Wake a snoozed key again (undo a snooze). Identify it by the digest card that was snoozed, or by the key itself (e.g. "source:techcrunch" or "ref:calendar_events:<id>").

def.name: star_digest_item
def.description: Pin a digest item by starring it. Stays visible across day rolls. Use when the operator wants to come back to something.

workflows.name: Digest · generate + prioritize
workflows.goal: The digest tick as one named chain: prune stale items, pull the two sources this install has (search headlines for the operator's topics, the calendar look-ahead), then score the fresh cards so the brief reads most-relevant first. Same pass the :30 cron runs; also runnable manually or by Nyo via run_workflow.

workflows.name: Digest · prioritize signals
workflows.goal: Score every unread, unscored digest card of a scored kind (0-100 + reason, plugin-digest-signal-priority rubric): cards worth acting on rise to high urgency, background noise sinks. Fires after digest generation; also runnable manually or by Nyo via run_workflow.

workflows.name: Digest · learn from dismissals
workflows.goal: The consideration layer's learn pass: harvest recently dismissed-not-starred items, distill avoid-patterns through the llm gateway, and append them to the plugin-digest-interests note the scorer reads. No-op below the new-dismissals threshold, so it is safe on every cron tick.
